fact: TechCabal refers to mHub as an incubator in Malawi with a former CEO, with no programme or cohort described.
The Secretary for Information and Digitalization says 10 tech hubs under the Digital Malawi Project have trained over 19,000 people in digital skills and given some beneficiaries seed funding.
The ministry said it has supported 10 tech hubs with over $3 million in start-up grants; no programme or cohort described.
